people.name: Feng Boyi
people.title: Chief curator, Art Macao: Macao International Art Biennale 2025
previously: Artistic Director, He Xiangning Art Museum
Artistic Director, Suzhou Jinji Lake Art Museum

basis: Macao Government Information Bureau releases of 18 June and 4 September 2025 name Feng Boyi as chief curator of the 2025 edition, the latest found.
A Xinhua report of 15 August 2026 quotes Zhou Feng as director (馆长) of the memorial hall.
The museum's own About Us overview, on a site showing its 2026 programme, names its two founding collectors as the people behind it and names no director.

An M+ press release of 11 April 2025 quotes Gong Yan as Director of Power Station of Art, and a Mondriaan Fund visitor profile for May 2025 gives the same post; the museum's own site is a script page that shows no staff.

basis: The museum's homepage (2026 programme) names X Zhu-Nowell as Executive Director and Chief Curator, STIR (25 April 2025) dates the post from January 2025, and ArtAsiaPacific (15 February 2023) gives the artistic director appointment; no source found says when the previous director Liu Yingjiu left, so no predecessor is listed.
